Only 23% of 4,441 remote listings reveal pay. What does that mean for job seekers?

Our latest data from Loker Dollar shows that 77% of remote jobs hide compensation. But that doesn't mean low wages—many firms expect negotiation.

Key numbers:
• 4,441 active remote listings
• 1,000 (23%) disclose pay
• 2,753 (62%) open to worldwide applicants
• 1,560 companies hiring
• Top skills: Communication (39%), AI (12%), Leadership (10%)

Only Neo Financial discloses a rate ($5/hour). TELUS Health, IDG, Hitachi, and Jobgether don't.

Want to find USD-paying remote work? Filter for 'worldwide remote' on Loker Dollar and apply before listings close.

Read the full analysis: https://lokerdollar.com/en/blog/global-remote-jobs-2026
